# apple_app_custom_product_page_localization (Resource)

Adds a locale to a custom product page, with its promotional text. Use the resource's `id` as the `custom_product_page_localization_id` of `apple_app_asset_library_placement` to show screenshots and previews. A change to a locale the current version has is made in that version; a new locale goes to the version being prepared, and when the current version has been reviewed, applying starts the next one. Adding a locale fails while a version is in review. Destroying the resource deletes the localization from the version being prepared, and otherwise leaves it. Import it with `<custom_product_page_id>/<locale>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_app_custom_product_page_localization" "en_US" {
  custom_product_page_id = apple_app_custom_product_page.summer.id
  locale                 = "en-US"
  promotional_text       = "Play the summer cup."
}

# A screenshot on the page.
resource "apple_app_asset_library_placement" "summer" {
  image_id                            = apple_app_asset_library_image.summer.id
  custom_product_page_localization_id = apple_app_custom_product_page_localization.en_US.id
  placement_type                      = "APP_SCREENSHOT"
  placement_group                     = "IPHONE_DYNAMIC_ISLAND_LARGE_PROFILE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `custom_product_page_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the custom product page, e.g. `apple_app_custom_product_page.example.id`.
- `locale` (String) Locale, e.g. `en-US`.

### Optional

- `promotional_text` (String) Promotional text shown above the description, up to 170 characters.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the localization, which changes with each version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_custom_product_page_localization.en_US
  identity = {
    custom_product_page_id = "eb2b3606-2fef-4aab-a54e-b2e5547c9bc3"
    locale                 = "en-US"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `custom_product_page_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the custom product page, e.g. `apple_app_custom_product_page.example.id`.
- `locale` (String) Locale, e.g. `en-US`.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <custom_product_page_id>/<locale>
terraform import apple_app_custom_product_page_localization.en_US eb2b3606-2fef-4aab-a54e-b2e5547c9bc3/en-US
```
